name: @focus-mode/agent
description: Focus Agent — Electron companion app: pairing code, local WS link, visible focus state, OS window control.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');fs.mkdirSync('dist/ui',{recursive:true});for(const f of ['index.html','styles.css'])fs.copyFileSync('src/ui/'+f,'dist/ui/'+f)"
